claims.text: The C4 model distinguishes system context, containers, components and code.
claims.reason: The original C4 documentation defines the four scopes.

claims.text: An evaluator-optimizer workflow uses evaluation and feedback to revise generated work.
claims.reason: The pattern is explicitly described by the primary source.

claims.text: Research evaluation benefits from different checks for groundedness, coverage and judgment.
claims.reason: The source distinguishes grader types and research-evaluation concerns.

claims.text: Claude Code supports project instructions in CLAUDE.md.
GitHub Copilot documents repository instructions in .github/copilot-instructions.md.
claims.reason: Current documentation was retrieved; host support must be checked.

claims.text: The supplied Python coordinator persists stages and binds reviews to canonical content fingerprints.
Shared evidence, architecture and story records may reduce material drift in recurring architecture publications.
claims.reason: This is the central design hypothesis; a comparative evaluation is still needed.

claims.text: A writable local run folder is not a tamper-proof approval boundary.
claims.reason: The same writer can modify checks, state and review declarations.
claims.could_change_if: Execution and approval are separated by independently enforced permissions.

claims.text: The core coordinator and SVG/Mermaid generator do not call a model API or require a vendor SDK.
claims.reason: The shipped core imports Python standard-library modules only.

claims.text: The example code-level diagram names actual classes in gates.py.
claims.reason: GateEngine, ArtifactStore, Finding and ReviewStamp appear in the supplied module.

claims.text: Adoption should depend on a bounded pilot against a simpler authoring baseline.
claims.reason: The extra process needs to demonstrate decision quality or lower material rework.

coverage.question: What do the four views mean?
coverage.answer: Use original C4 definitions and parent containment.

coverage.question: Does this loop measurably improve publications?
coverage.answer: Unknown; recommend only a controlled pilot.

coverage.question: Can one prompt guarantee safety or truth?
coverage.answer: No such claim is made; writable records and self-review are limited.

coverage.question: Will every host integration work unmodified?
coverage.answer: Not established; conventions are documented, host sessions are untested.

stop_reason: Primary definitions and adapter conventions were retrieved. Product effectiveness and end-to-end host behavior require empirical trials; more general web searching would not resolve those gaps.
